reported_success.quote: This claim was replicated in both mail and robust analysis estimation.

notes: Input supplied no study/outcome/test locator or description. The named primary replication report identifies one single-trace claim, coded claim 4, which was used to identify the replication test. Original article full text was not obtained: DOI landing page abstract only; Unpaywall and OpenAlex no OA location; Europe PMC no match; institutional repository route returned 403. Original statistics quoted secondhand in the replication report were not substituted for original-paper extraction. Replication coefficient is retained with the report’s printed metric label; no conversion performed. Replication analytic n is not printed. An unsolicited search-engine result from a prohibited secondary source appeared in broad primary-paper search results; it was not opened or used.
